strips.title: A robot with no camera: in real life

panels.head: Before the run
panels.text: Pick up cords, socks and toys: a laser maps walls, not socks.

panels.head: Map once
panels.text: Draw no-go zones round the desk cables and the pet bowls.

panels.head: Pet alone?
panels.text: Do not schedule it while a sick pet is home: it cannot see a mess.

panels.head: Privacy
panels.text: Skip the data-sharing program in the app. No photos to share anyway.
